name: Night Pump
storyline:
Set in the desolate outskirts of Route 9, Jack—a 19-year-old starting his first graveyard shift—finds himself isolated at the Rot’N Gas station. What begins as a routine night of serving eccentric customers and restocking shelves quickly dissolves into a nightmare.

Haunted by the mysterious disappearance of the previous employee and watched by shadows in the surrounding forest, Jack must navigate a series of increasingly disturbing encounters. In this town, the darkness doesn't just hide secrets; it hunts. Every choice made under the flickering fluorescent lights will determine if Jack survives until dawn or becomes another forgotten headline in the woods
summary:
Night Pump is a short first-person horror game set during a night shift at Route 9 Gas, an isolated gas station surrounded by nothing but forest and darkness.

A night shift at an isolated gas station. Strange customers. Strange noises. Serve customers, manage the register, and try to ignore the feeling that something is very wrong tonight. Some customers will buy things. Some will just talk. And some should never have walked through that door.

When the lights go out, there is nowhere to run.
